Diabetes
•	 Refer adolescent with family history of diabetes, signs of acan-
thosis nigricans, symptoms consistent with diabetes or those 
who are overweight/obese to a primary care provider and re-
quest a fasting blood glucose.
•	 Review fasting blood glucose levels with adolescent and 
parent(s). Provide nutrition counseling as appropriate.
•	 If adolescent is overweight, provide dietary counseling in ac-
cordance with Step 1.
•	 If adolescent is obese, provide dietary counseling in accor-
dance with Step 2 and refer to comprehensive weight manage-
ment program.

and request a fasting blood glucose.
•	 Review fasting blood glucose levels with client. Provide 
nutrition counseling as appropriate.
•	 If client is overweight or obese, provide dietary counseling 
and refer to comprehensive weight management program.
Physical activity
